zh: 從台塑到營德，厚植製造實力
old_en: From Formosa Plastics to INTEPLAST TAIWAN—strengthening manufacturing expertise

zh: 臺灣營德的製造故事，源自台塑塑膠加工組。1983 年，加工組於高雄前鎮廠起步，開始生產購物袋；1984 年，市場袋、清潔袋正式加入產品線，逐步累積袋品製造的基礎與經驗。
old_en: INTEPLAST TAIWAN's manufacturing story traces back to Formosa Plastics' processing group. In 1983, the group began at the Kaohsiung Qianzhen plant with shopping bag production; produce bags and can liners followed in 1984, building the foundation for decades of bag manufacturing expertise.

zh: 1989 年，新港廠整地擴建；1991 年正式投產，並啟用全自動拌料輸送系統。隨著市場需求與設備能力提升，產品線也持續延伸。
old_en: Xingang expanded in 1989 and began production in 1991 with an automated mixing and conveying system. As market demand and capability grew, the product portfolio continued to expand.

zh: 2004 年，前鎮廠遷廠合併，新港成為主要生產基地；2008 年，全球產品配置重整，讓製造資源更聚焦於具技術與品質優勢的產品。
old_en: In 2004, the Qianzhen operation was consolidated and Xingang became the primary production base. A 2008 global product realignment sharpened the focus on products with technical and quality advantages.

zh: 2014 年，台塑塑膠加工組改組，成立「臺灣營德股份有限公司」。臺灣營德延續既有的製造經驗，結合 INTEPLAST GROUP 的全球技術與營運管理，並持續作為台塑相關企業的一員，開啟新的篇章。
old_en: In 2014, the Formosa Plastics processing group was reorganized as INTEPLAST TAIWAN CORPORATION. Building on its manufacturing experience and INTEPLAST GROUP's global technology and operations, INTEPLAST TAIWAN continues as part of the Formosa Plastics affiliated enterprise network.

zh: 2015 年，越南營德公司成立，進一步拓展海外製造布局。透過臺灣與越南生產基地的相互支援，結合 INTEPLAST GROUP 的全球資源與技術經驗，逐步強化產能配置與國際市場供應能力。
old_en: In 2015, INTEPLAST VIETNAM was established, extending the manufacturing footprint overseas. With the Taiwan and Vietnam plants supporting each other and drawing on INTEPLAST GROUP's global resources and technical experience, capacity planning and international supply capability continued to strengthen.

zh: 環保標章以綠色葉片環繞地球的意象，傳遞守護環境、珍惜資源的理念。取得標章的產品，須符合環境部公告的規格標準並獲得使用證書，讓消費者採購時有清楚的辨識依據。
old_en: The Green Mark uses green leaves surrounding the Earth to convey environmental protection and resource conservation. Certified products meet official standards from the Ministry of Environment, providing clear purchasing guidance.

zh: 綠色消費的觀念在歐美環保運動中逐漸發展，德國、加拿大、日本與北歐等地也陸續建立環保標章制度。台灣於民國81年推動環保標章，鼓勵製造端減少污染與資源消耗，也讓使用者能支持可回收、低污染與省資源的產品。
old_en: Green consumerism evolved from global environmental movements. Taiwan introduced its Green Mark system in 1992, encouraging manufacturers to reduce pollution and resource consumption.

zh: 環保標章規格標準

依 ISO 14024 原則建立

old_en: Adheres to Type I environmental labeling principles under ISO 14024 to encourage eco-friendly products.

zh: 從產品生命週期看環境
